practice_phrases.known: I want to know everything about you.
practice_phrases.target: 我想知道关于你的一切。

practice_phrases.known: You don't have to explain everything.
I don't need to understand everything to start speaking.
practice_phrases.target: 我不需要理解一切就能开始说话。

practice_phrases.known: You can't remember everything, but you can try.
practice_phrases.target: 你不能记住一切，但你可以试试。

practice_phrases.known: I want to learn everything, but I know it takes time.
practice_phrases.target: 我想学习一切，但我知道这需要时间。

practice_phrases.known: Everything is difficult at first, but it gets easier.
practice_phrases.target: 一切在开始时都很难，但会变得容易。
